a.xlink:title: Entry point for the accumulator suite.
Runs a named C test suite and prints pass/fail progress markers.
Component counts follow the documented product shapes.
A constant field yields exactly zero product at every point.
A vector-scalar covariance reproduces its analytically known components.
A covariance member missing from the field list is rejected, not silently skipped.
Derived quantities reproduce the analytic values the accumulated state implies.
Three accepted states reproduce the analytically known moments at every point.
Masked points accumulate nothing, and remain distinguishable from unsampled ones.
A cell's particles form the same state the streaming accumulator builds.
A particle-sampled field is accumulated over the occupied states only.
Payload enumeration covers every vector exactly once with stable names.
A homogeneous merge equals the moments of the slot's pooled sample set.
A homogeneous merge of a particle-sampled field pools only its occupied samples.
The runloop entry point applies exactly the states the schedule accepts.
A field's covariance with itself reduces exactly to its own second moment.
The spatial mean divides by sampled points, not by the whole vector.
Storage allocates one mean per field and the right number of product components.
A point blanked from the start is reported as never valid.
The valid-fraction range reports mask coverage, including a never-valid point.
Unequal weights reproduce the weighted result the kernels define.
Asserts that two integer values are equal.
Reports how many components a covariance between two fields needs.
Reports how many symmetric product components a field's second moment needs.
Builds a definition requesting Ucat and P with second moments.
Asserts that one boolean condition is true.
Asserts that two real values agree within tolerance.
Builds minimal SimCtx and UserCtx fixtures for C unit tests.
Destroys minimal SimCtx/UserCtx fixtures and all owned PETSc objects.
Applies one accepted completed state to a window's accumulators.
Allocates the accumulator state one window owns on one block.
Releases accumulator state previously created for one window.
Reads one component of a multi-component accumulator vector at an interior point.
Reads one interior point of a scalar accumulator vector.
Sets Ucat to a uniform vector and P to a uniform scalar.
Builds minimal SimCtx and UserCtx fixtures for C unit tests with configurable periodicity.
Broadcasts the bounding box information collected on rank 0 to all other ranks.
Computes the local bounding box of the grid on the current process.
Creates a DMDA sharing a block's decomposition at a different degree of freedom.
Duplicates and zeroes a vector.
Allocates and zeroes a global vector from the provided DM.
Allocates and zeroes a local vector from the provided DM.
Gathers local bounding boxes from all MPI processes to rank 0.
Installs the shipped defaults for every LES closure parameter.
Populates identity metric vectors on the minimal grid fixture.
Populates cell center coordinates for a uniform grid on [0,1]^3.
Destroys a PETSc DM only when the handle is non-null.
Destroys a PETSc KSP only when the handle is non-null.
Destroys a PETSc matrix only when the handle is non-null.
Destroys a PETSc nullspace only when the handle is non-null.
Destroys a PETSc random generator only when the handle is non-null.
Frees any runtime storage allocated for solution-convergence logging.
Destroys a PETSc vector only when the handle is non-null.
Frees an entire linked list of boundary-condition parameters.
Resolve the existing DM and global/local vectors for one field.
Internal helper: locates the storage slot holding one field's running mean.
Applies one weighted paired sample to a co-moment accumulator.
Applies one weighted sample to a scalar moment accumulator.

Physical scale one field is multiplied by to leave non-dimensional form.
